description: Frozen gate of the memory evals (#225). It applies to a complete run of the deployed vector variant; later slices may only raise it (raise a minimum, lower a maximum), never loosen it.
method: Both baselines ran on 2026-11-21 over the complete question set (45 measured cases) with the fictional demo seed, the fictional dataset documents and the settings recorded in each summary: voyage-4, candidate pool 30, 6 final passages, relevance floor 0.3.
The quality minimums are the vector baseline's values rounded down to two decimals.
falseEmptyRate is frozen at the measured 0.

latencyP95Ms bounds retrieval after the query is embedded (the run embeds the questions in its candidates step, so every measured search comes from the query cache); the measured 74 ms gets headroom for a slower machine.
costPerQueryUsd bounds an uncached query embedding (about USD 0.0000006 in the 2026-11-20 run) with headroom; cached runs measure 0.
The full-text-only baseline stays below the vector variant on every quality metric except the correct-empty rate, which is the same 0.2 in both: the placeholder relevance floor is not calibrated yet.
